ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 cancellation fee to the rider's original payment method; no driver violation flag or account action (the driver's arrival tap was genuine, 40 m from pickup).
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled and the app reason recorded is rider_no_show, so the case falls under NS-1/NS-2 [F4][NS-0]. NS-1 makes the $5.00 fee stand only if every condition holds; one condition fails, so the fee is voided under NS-2.

Arrival was genuine: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:32:45 within 200 m of the pickup (40 m; closest approach 38 m) and stayed at the point, so NS-1(iii) is satisfied by 2 messages (first 21:33:15) and 1 call (21:34:15) before the 21:37:35 cancellation [F1][F5][F7][NS-1].

But the free-wait condition fails. Counting from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival — arrival at 21:32:45 — the driver was continuously at the pickup for only 4 min 50 s (290 s) before cancelling, short of the 5-minute free wait (300 s) [F2][F3][F6][F7][NS-1]. The rider's chat and the driver's own "more than 5 min already" message do not extend the record; the system timeline does [F10][F11][F4].

Since a required NS-1 condition fails, NS-2 voids the $5.00 fee and this is a refund_full of the cancellation fee on record [F8][NS-2]. No account action follows: the arrival tap was not false (40 m from pickup), so the flag_account branch of NS-2 does not apply [F7][F1][NS-2]. The rider's own profile (936 days, 4.9, 0 disputes) does not decide the case [F18].

Safety screen: I read all chat messages, the driver's statement and the complaint — a driver waiting message, a "I have to cancel" message, the call log, the written statement, and the rider's complaint. Nothing threatening, intimidating, harassing, sexual or about dangerous driving; the tone is a routine no-show dispute [F10][F11][F13][F14][NS-0]. Safety_concern = none.

The record settles every element of this ruling (GPS arrival, continuous presence, wait duration, messages and call, cancellation time), so evidence is sufficient and no GPS or timing gap exists [F1][F2][F3][F5][F6][F7].
